visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video features a split-screen format. The top half displays cinematic cutscenes from the video game 'Wuthering Waves,' featuring the character Phrolova, while the bottom half shows a female cosplayer dressed as the character playing the theme on a grand piano. The cosplayer has long, mint-green hair in a thick braid and wears a detailed red and white dress. (2) As the video progresses, the anime portion showcases various battle animations and magical effects involving red threads and blooming lilies. The pianist's hands are seen moving rhythmically across the piano keys, with her hair resting against her back. The studio background is composed of dark red vertical curtains. (3) The anime character Phrolova is seen performing high-energy attacks with glowing red visual effects, while the cosplayer continues to play the melody with focused intensity. Lighting in the lower half is bright and professional, highlighting the texture of the piano and the costume. (4) The video concludes with the game's logo appearing over an anime field of red flowers, while the pianist finishes the piece and remains seated. Character text overlays appear periodically in stylized fonts in the upper section.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 遥味世世的梦. [Logo]: 弗洛洛 Phrolova. (2) [Subtitle]: 與影子不再見. (3) [Subtitle]: 就稍微等一下.... (4) [Subtitle]: 一同共赴.... (5) [Subtitle]: 凋零吧. (6) [Subtitle]: 接着吧, 礼. (7) [Subtitle]: 诶嘿, 谢谢! (8) [Subtitle]: 該摸, 打扮脸容. (9) [Subtitle]: 嗯.... (10) [Subtitle]: 死亡即眠, 死亡即道. (11) [Subtitle]: 願有朝成為不生不滅的永恒存在時. [Logo]: 鳴潮 WUTHERING WAVES.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A female cosplayer with long, braided mint-green hair, wearing a white and red backless dress with matching sleeves, seated at a piano.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The bottom half is a music studio with red vertical drapes and a glossy black grand piano. The top half cycles through various fantasy environments from the game, including ruins and fields of red flowers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a solo piano performance, playing a melodic and slightly melancholic theme in a moderate tempo. (2) A female voice speaks a line in Mandarin with a calm, breathy tone, while the piano continues. A magic-like sparkle SFX is heard. (3) Transient impact SFX and whoosh sounds occur, synchronized with visual game actions, while the piano melody becomes more complex and rhythmic. (4) Another vocal line is delivered with low arousal and falling intonation. The piano maintains a consistent, high-fidelity acoustic presence throughout. (5) As the music builds, mechanical percussive thuds from the piano action are faintly audible. The track ends with a final sustaining chord and a soft vocal exclamation, followed by a gradual fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Performance -> Game Cinematic Integration -> Logo Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a live piano cover of a theme from the game 'Wuthering Waves' while performing as the character Phrolova in high-quality cosplay, serving both as entertainment and a promotional highlight for the game.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear presence of game cinematics, character cosplay, and the official 'Wuthering Waves' logo at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes a split-screen layout to bridge real-world performance with digital game content, creating a strong synergistic appeal for the gaming community.
